name: staggered-fade-up
title: Staggered Fade Up
description: Words slide up and fade in one after another in a wave-like cascade: a neutral, versatile headline reveal.
useWhen: A headline or body sentence is long and a single-unit entrance would feel flat.
You want a neutral, versatile word-by-word reveal that suits any brand tone.
The text must be fully on screen by a known time: stagger delay times word count gives the total.
avoidWhen: The text is very short (one or two words): use scale-down-fade or spring-scale-in.
You want a per-character reveal: use soft-blur-in.
The scene needs an exit animation: this is an entrance only.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Sentence whose words fade up one by one.

variables.label: Stagger delay
variables.description: Frames (30 per second) between one word and the next.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far below its place each word starts.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.
